# WorldCat.org

> WorldCat.org is a global library catalog and discovery platform enabling users to search books, music, videos, articles and other resources across millions of library collections worldwide.

WorldCat.org serves as a comprehensive resource discovery platform operated by OCLC, connecting patrons with library materials and providing tools for both researchers and librarians to navigate global library collections.

## Core Discovery Features

- [WorldCat.org Homepage](https://search.worldcat.org): Global library catalog for searching books, music, video, articles and more
- [Topics](https://search.worldcat.org/topics): Topic-based research guides and search scenarios for library discovery
- [Lists](https://search.worldcat.org/lists): User-curated lists feature for discovering and sharing library collections

## Library Resources & Information

- [About WorldCat.org](https://search.worldcat.org/about): Information about WorldCat.org, OCLC partnerships and library resources
- [For Librarians](https://search.worldcat.org/for-librarians): Guide for librarians on listing libraries in WorldCat.org and web visibility
